reason: Attacked and survived, and the attack was worth making because this is one of the most smoothed sentences in American quotation. I downloaded the named text itself, Project Gutenberg ebook 3176, whose own header states [From an 1869--1st Edition], so the edition named on the card is the edition read. At line 18703 the text reads: Travel is fatal to prejudice, bigotry and narrow-mindedness, and many of our people need it sorely on these accounts. That is the proposal character for character, including the point the verifier's note flags: there is no comma after bigotry. The card is therefore on the right side of the drift, and the Calendar For Life candidate it replaces, cflId 1, is the drifted form with the extra comma, so this line does the job the carry is for. The locator holds too, and I checked it rather than took it. CONCLUSION. stands alone at line 18641; CHAPTER LXI. begins at line 18400 and ends before it; the sentence sits in the third paragraph of the Conclusion, the one beginning I have no fault to find with the manner in which our excursion was conducted, exactly as the evidence says. So the correction the verifier made, moving the line out of chapter LXI and into the Conclusion, is right. The sentence ends in a full stop in the source and the quotation ends where the source's sentence ends; nothing is spliced, and the sentence that follows, about broad wholesome charitable views, is left off cleanly. Attribution: genuinely Twain's own prose in his own book, not reported, not a character's line, so no speaker is owed. The misattribution list does carry Twain, but for Dance like nobody's watching, which is a 1987 country lyric; it has nothing to do with this line and this line is not a trap of that kind. shipped.js resolves the person to samuel clemens, returns no shipped hit, no near-hit, zero for the year, not banned, not at cap. No second Twain sits in the May carry-ins. Tag Essay is defensible and consistent with the track's own precedent: carry-in 02-cfl-03 tags Stevenson's The Silverado Squatters Essay, and The Innocents Abroad is the same form, non-fiction prose travel writing, for which Essay is the only fit in the closed vocabulary of seven. Scope is clean: 1869, not scripture, not film, not lyric, not proverb, not oratory, not business writing, nothing needing a warning. Theme fits Wisdom and Counsel: it is counsel in the imperative mood without the imperative, and it is a morning line rather than a bleak one. Form of the source line: leads with Mark Twain, no dash of any kind, no straight double quote, 84 characters. The note carries no dash and no straight quote either. I could not break it.

residual: None that bears on shipping. The only judgement call left is the tag: Essay for a travel book is a stretch of the closed vocabulary, but it is the stretch the track already made for Stevenson in 02-cfl-03, so consistency argues for keeping it.
